items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: Orrin Keepnews — I asked him if he had a definition or a philosophy about producing

ctx.x: I was. Soaking it all in, you know like the fly on the wall, a very big fly on the wall.

Orrin Keepnews — I asked him if he had a definition or a philosophy about producing and he said, he described it as being a catalytic agent creating a circumstance where an artist can work most effectively.

That’s a good way of putting it. But you know what it really boiled down to me was being able to relate to the musicians and to the business of music. See for a long time I didn’t relate to music as a business. I just did it and I made money at it. I wasn’t that aware of the greater music business. But then when we were working with this producer with Phil and then they had a big falling out because it turns out the guy was padding the budgets and keeping the money. He was basically stealing. And he’s dead now so…
